opportunities.program: Hong Kong-Singapore Joint Call for Proposals
opportunities.funder: Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR)
opportunities.summary: A bilateral research grant call between Hong Kong and Singapore listed under A*STAR's ongoing grant calls.
opportunities.eligibility_reason: The page does not provide eligibility criteria for this grant call.
opportunities.fit_rationale: The call may support international collaborative research in computer science, but specific thematic priorities are not detailed on this page.

opportunities.summary: Amazon Research Awards opens its Fall 2026 call for proposals across nine research areas, including Agentic AI and Automated Reasoning. ARA provides grant recipients with unrestricted funds, AWS promotional credits, an Amazon research contact, and training resources.
opportunities.deadline_quote: The deadline for submissions is November 4, 2026 at 11:59PM Pacific Time.
opportunities.eligibility_quote: Before applying, we encourage researchers to visit the ARA website and read our frequently asked questions for more specific program information.
opportunities.eligibility_reason: The call welcomes researchers and proposals related to theory, practice, and novel techniques, but does not state specific institutional, geographic, or career-stage eligibility criteria on the page, directing applicants to the ARA website and FAQ.
opportunities.fit_rationale: The call features Agentic AI and Automated Reasoning as core research areas, which directly aligns with the lab's research on agent governance, contract runtimes, and automated verification for autonomous research agents.

opportunities.program: AWS Cloud Credit for Research Program
opportunities.summary: The AWS Public Sector Cloud Credit for Research Program provides AWS Promotional Credit to researchers to build cloud-hosted publicly available science-as-a-service applications, perform proof of concept or benchmark tests evaluating the efficacy of moving research workloads to the cloud, or train communities on cloud research workloads.
opportunities.deadline_quote: Amazon Web Services (AWS) will evaluate academic research support proposals on a rolling basis throughout the year.
opportunities.amount: Up to $5,000.00 for students; uncapped for faculty and staff
opportunities.amount_quote: Student awards will be up to a maximum of $5,000.00. Faculty and Staff awards are not capped.
opportunities.eligibility_quote: Full-time faculty at an accredited research institution
opportunities.eligibility_reason: The applicant is a full-time faculty member at an accredited academic research institution (Singapore Management University).
opportunities.fit_rationale: The credits directly support deploying cloud-hosted tools and running compute-heavy benchmarks, which fits OPAL's need for infrastructure to run agent contracts, verification gates, and autonomous research workloads.

opportunities.summary: Anthropic's External Researcher Access Program provides free Claude API credits ($1,000 standard allocation, or higher in rare special cases) to researchers working on high-priority AI safety and alignment topics.
opportunities.deadline_quote: We evaluate submissions on the first Monday of each month.
opportunities.amount_quote: If successful, we will apply $1000 in API credits to the account. For rare special cases, we may approve a higher quantity of credit.
opportunities.eligibility_quote: If you are an alignment researcher and are interested in receiving free API credits for AI safety and alignment research purposes, you might qualify for our External Researcher Access Program.
opportunities.eligibility_reason: The applicant conducts AI safety and agent governance research, but the page does not specify which safety/alignment topics Anthropic considers high priority, nor does it list which countries have official Claude availability.
opportunities.fit_rationale: The lab investigates AI safety and agent governance for autonomous agents, which aligns well with Anthropic's alignment focus, and API credits are needed for LLM agent runtime experiments.

opportunities.summary: OpenAI provides subsidized API credits to researchers studying areas related to the responsible deployment of AI, mitigating associated risks, alignment, misuse potential, and understanding the societal impact of AI systems.
opportunities.deadline_quote: applications are reviewed once every 3 months (in March, June, September, and December).
opportunities.amount_quote: Researchers can apply for up to $1,000 of OpenAI API credits to support their work.
opportunities.eligibility_quote: We encourage applications from early stage researchers in countries supported by our API
opportunities.eligibility_reason: The program encourages early stage researchers from API-supported countries (which includes Singapore) with limited institutional resources; as a faculty member, it is unclear whether the applicant meets these preferred criteria, though there is no strict prohibition.
opportunities.fit_rationale: OPAL's focus on autonomous agent governance, accountability, and human-AI interaction closely aligns with OpenAI's interest in alignment, misuse potential, and human-AI interaction.
